propositions: The code-review extension seam does not dynamically fan in activated project-criteria LLM prompts into Pass 1; project routing describes criteria but Round-A execution omits them.
The code-review eval/CLI resolution surface is plan-review-biased and does not admit project criteria through the existing solver arm.
Pass 3 does not consistently apply repository-effective threshold, posture, and nit-suppression values when routing project-criteria findings.
A co-located project criterion named project.review-phase-boundaries must enforce four-phase contract boundaries (discover, assess, decide, coach) without permitting cross-phase directive drift.
The integration seam repair must map logical project.<name> ids to validator-safe physical code-review-project-<name> ids and preserve overlay-absent repository compatibility.
